scorecard: CUE analysis, Auto mode (Intelligent Cue Creation, djmdCue)
code: crates/mb-analysis/src/cue.rs (22.05 kHz collector, getScores, getTotalScores, candidates), crates/mb-nn/src/ort.rs (open_cue, f64 tensors), crates/mb-library/src/cue_analysis.rs (auto_plan), crates/mb-library/src/analyse.rs (ApplyAnalysis step E)
commands: cargo run --release -p mb-library --example cue_score -- A1 A2
MB_CUE_OWN=1 cargo run --release -p mb-library --example cue_score -- A1
test: cargo test -p mb-library --test analyse_ops auto_cue_analysis_matches_oracle_cue (MB_ORACLE_FULL=1 for every track)

oracle-cue/A1.settings: Auto, HOT CUE, limit 8, 1.1Bars on, comments on, all-zero personal tendency

oracle-cue/A2.settings: Auto, MEMORY CUE, limit 8, otherwise as A1

input: rekordbox's grid (PQTZ, PQT2 offset) and phrases (PSSI) of each run; the audio from our own decode
columns: Kind, InMsec, InFrame, OutMsec, Comment, Color, ColorTableIndex, ActiveLoop, BeatLoopSize, CueMicrosec, InMpegFrame, InMpegAbs
stages_vs_rekordbox: getScores and getTotalScores identical to rekordbox's own functions in a native harness on the same decode (scores bit for bit, the same 16 candidates)
runtime_inputs: samplecnn.onnx and cue_prediction_model_no_abs_position.onnx from the install (MD5-checked); nothing copied into the repo
seconds_per_track: about 0.7 (decode + CNN per phrase start), 169 tracks in 2 min for A1+A2
pending: a non-zero personal CUE tendency ([CUE Analysis Playlist]); no reference run
